answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 3628 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: I am an indian but working in dubai. I have a question and confusion in my mind about my over time earning. My duty timing is 7:30 am to 5 pm but my manager force me to do overtime work (untill 7 pm) but due to my phisical and mentally tiredness or some times due to mood less i cannt concentrate on my work so many times I just seat in the office and I get overtime money for that therefore please advice me what to do. Question: I am an indian but working in dubai. I have a question and confusion in my mind about my over time earning. My duty timing is 7:30 am to 5 pm but my manager force me to do overtime work (untill 7 pm) but due to my phisical and mentally tiredness or some times due to mood less i cannt concentrate on my work so many times I just seat in the office and I get overtime money for that therefore please advice me what to do. Answer ID: 3628 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 303/305=LM) The money you are getting is against work, if you are not working in those extra times then you are not entitled to receive the payment for the same: قال فی الدر المختار: ولیس للخاص أ ن یعمل لغیرہ، ولو عمل نقص من أ جرتہ بقدر ما عمل ( الدر المختار مع الشامی: 9/96 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
